# Site check: mychata.cz after the T-038 publish, 18 Oct 2026

Run about 03:15–03:25 Czech time from a cloud session by the site-check subagent. Read-only: no sign-in, no clicks that change data, no forms sent, only made-up tokens opened. The Chrome DevTools MCP was not available, so the subagent ran the e2e suite and its own headless Chromium script (375×812, DPR 2, cs-CZ) and used curl for the raw HTML.

**Live commit: `d52dfd0`** (`<meta name="build-sha" content="d52dfd0b4102643c9292431c41bee8ede4659ec6">`, `build-time` `2026-10-18T01:06:17.309Z`). That is Lovable's commit of 01:05 UTC, merged to `main` as PR #55 (`bcd752a`, 01:09 UTC). It contains PR #52 and PR #54 (T-038), and its files are identical to `main` at `bcd752a`. **T-038 is live.**

| ------------------------- | ------ | --------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `/`                       | 200    | none (0 console, 0 page errors, 0 HTTP ≥ 400) | Raw title "My Chata — správa sdílené chaty", then the sign-in screen with "Přihlášení — My Chata"                                                   |
| `/auth`                   | 200    | none                                          | Title "Přihlášení — My Chata". All 4 options present. LCP 0.9–1.1 s (the photo), CLS 0. Cookie banner flush at the bottom (simulated CZ, see below) |
| `/verejne/kalendar/x`     | 200    | none                                          | "Tento odkaz na kalendář neplatí. Požádejte správce chaty o aktuální odkaz." Title "Kalendář chaty — My Chata"                                      |
| `/verejne/zadost/x`       | 200    | none                                          | "Tento odkaz na formulář neplatí." Title "Žádost o pobyt — My Chata"                                                                                |

The only failed requests on any page were Google Analytics `/g/collect` calls blocked by the session's proxy (sent with `gcs=G100`, `npa=1` on this US connection).

## e2e

`E2E_BASE_URL=https://mychata.cz bun run e2e` failed all 6 tests before any test ran: Playwright 1.63 wants Chromium headless shell build 1243 and the cloud container has build 1194. A tooling mismatch in this environment, not a site problem; `playwright install` was not run.

```
$ playwright test

Running 6 tests using 1 worker

  ✘  1 tests/e2e/public.spec.ts:5:1 › home page loads and shows sign-in (3ms)
  ✘  2 tests/e2e/public.spec.ts:10:1 › sign-in page offers Google and email (2ms)
  ✘  3 tests/e2e/public.spec.ts:15:1 › an unknown share token shows no calendar data (2ms)
  ✘  4 tests/e2e/public.spec.ts:23:1 › an invalid institution form link says so (6ms)
  ✘  5 tests/e2e/public.spec.ts:28:1 › an invalid guest link says so (4ms)
  ✘  6 tests/e2e/public.spec.ts:34:1 › sign-in page runs in the browser without console errors (5ms)

  1) tests/e2e/public.spec.ts:5:1 › home page loads and shows sign-in

    Error: browserType.launch: Executable doesn't exist at /opt/pw-browsers/chromium_headless_shell-1243/chrome-headless-shell-linux64/chrome-headless-shell
  [... same launch error for tests 2–6 ...]
  6 failed
error: script "e2e" exited with code 1
```

## Seen, not changed

- The 800 px autumn photo is 181 KB, large for its size; it is the LCP element.
- GA fires on every page for a US visitor without a consent choice (`gcs=G100`, non-personalised). Expected where no banner is required; not checked for EU visitors.

## Not verified

- A real EU visitor's cookie banner (simulated CZ answer only).
- A DevTools performance trace and INP (no DevTools MCP; INP needs a click, which was not allowed). LCP/CLS are from PerformanceObserver on an unthrottled connection.
- Photos for other seasons (only autumn served today).
- Anything signed in, including the T-038 fixes themselves; this check covers only the public pages.
